title: Skill
description: Front matter of temple/skills/<id>/SKILL.md: one skill (bí kíp), domain knowledge such as 'React + TanStack Query by this repo's conventions' or 'Playwright + axe' (product plan 0.5 §4, §6). A skill is not attached to any character: for each quest the runner loads at most 3 skills whose tags match the quest's tags and whose scope is global or the quest's territory (selectSkills in packages/domain), converting them to the CLI's own skill format in the worktree or inlining them in the prompt. The body below the front matter is written in English, like character prompts. Stage 1 has no skills: a territory's CLAUDE.md is its skill.
$comment: Hand-written v1, the reviewed target; from P0-03 generated by `pnpm schemas` from zod (ADR 0003). The path is the convention temple/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (plus attached files in the same folder), so it is not a field. Not expressible here: tags exist in registry/tags.json; scope is `global` or an existing territory id (a territory may not be named `global`); the body fits max_tokens; derived_from lessons exist and come from at least two characters.

id.description: Folder name under temple/skills/ (kebab-case: it is a file id).

description.description: One line: when this skill applies. Becomes the description of the CLI-native skill.

tags.description: Quest tags this skill applies to (registry/tags.json).

scope.description: `global`, or the id of the one territory this skill applies to. A territory skill ranks before a global one.

source.description: monk: written by the Temple from a lesson that repeats across characters and is a technique, not a habit; user: written by the owner.

derived_from.description: Lesson ids the Temple distilled this skill from; required when source = monk.

max_tokens.description: Size cap of the body and attached files; a skill that grows past it is split. The default is a starting value.
